Hi Susan — great news, and congrats on the signed SOW. Welcome aboard.

High-level plan (proposed):
1) Kickoff call (week of 8/31) to align the MAP and confirm RTOs.
2) Implementation sprint (2–3 weeks): SDK integration, basic telemetry, allowlist changes.
3) Cutover rehearsal and load-run (one-week window).
4) Production cutover and post-launch monitoring (October).

Can you confirm: preferred SDK language(s) (Node/Java/Python), whether requests will be server-side only, and any corporate proxy/egress limitations? Also confirm whether embeddings vs. generation traffic will be split across different endpoints or one combined route.

Sample quick guidance (we'll expand in the kickoff doc):
- Endpoint selection: use /v1/embeddings for vector workloads and /v1/generate (or chat) for text generation. We recommend pinning model version in the client (model_id param) and using short TTLs for caches if you plan to re-run queries.
- Retries/timeouts: client-side timeout 10s for single-token generation calls; 30s for larger completion requests; exponential backoff with jitter for 429/503 (base 200ms, max 10s, 5 retries).
- Rate limiting: use token bucket in front of your integration layer; for bursty traffic consider a local batching aggregator; we can provide batching suggestions tailored to your payload sizes.

I've looped in Marissa (implementation lead) and Monica (CSM) to coordinate the handoff and the kickoff docs. We'll prepare a short runbook with code snippets and firewall/allowlist details before the call.

Jonas Weber

- SDKs: Node.js (primary), Python (secondary).
- Requests: server-side only; calls go through our backend (no client-side keys).
- Egress: corporate proxy in front of services; we will provide proxy hostnames and a shortlived allowlist.
- Traffic: embeddings steady 150 TPS; generation ramp mostly during promos, expect bursts up to 450 TPS for 10–15 minute windows.
- Retention: 30 days for telemetry, no user-level PII to be sent.

We can do kickoff on Mon 8/31 at 10:30am PT. I've uploaded the allowlist CSV to the shared folder and attached it to this thread.
